title: Black Mass Flows Under Pressure: Battery Recycling Regulations
gist: Benchmark webinar listing in which Freddie Bloomfield and Dr Beatrice Browning analyse regional approaches to black mass and critical mineral security, trade flows and pricing; the page itself contains only the summary plus a catalogue of related Benchmark webinars on defence demand, midstream chemistry, lithium price risk and US critical minerals policy.

insights.claim: Benchmark frames battery recycling black mass as a critical mineral security issue, with regional regulatory approaches reshaping black mass trade flows and pricing dynamics.
insights.speaker: Dr Beatrice Browning, Frederick Bloomfield - Benchmark
insights.so_what: Recycling feedstock is becoming a policy-controlled strategic material, affecting recyclers' access and margins.
insights.quote: analyse regional approaches to black mass and critical mineral security

insights.claim: Black mass flows are described as being 'under pressure' from battery recycling regulation as of September 2026.
insights.speaker: Dr Beatrice Browning, Frederick Bloomfield - Benchmark
insights.so_what: Regulatory tightening could restrict cross-border black mass trade.
insights.quote: Black Mass Flows Under Pressure: Battery Recycling Regulation Deep Dive

insights.claim: Benchmark highlights rising defence spending, including drone manufacturing, as a new demand driver for battery and critical mineral supply chains dominated by China.
insights.speaker: Dr Beatrice Browning, Frederick Bloomfield - Benchmark
insights.so_what: Defence demand adds a security-premium buyer to battery materials markets.
insights.quote: strategic sourcing of the required critical minerals in a supply chain dominated by China

insights.claim: Growing EV and battery energy storage system (BESS) demand is described as driving fundamental changes in cell chemistry and battery midstream manufacturing.
insights.speaker: Dr Beatrice Browning, Frederick Bloomfield - Benchmark
insights.so_what: Chemistry shifts redistribute value across midstream producers.
insights.quote: driving fundamental changes across the battery value chain

insights.claim: US reindustrialisation for critical minerals and manufacturing is framed as constrained not only by policy but by availability of land, power and permitting.
insights.speaker: Dr Beatrice Browning, Frederick Bloomfield - Benchmark
insights.so_what: Physical bottlenecks, not just subsidies, will gate US critical mineral project timelines.
insights.quote: US reindustrialisation depends not just on policy, but on the availability of land, power and permitting

insights.claim: Policy clarity on permitting, regulation and the legal framework is presented as critical to commercial development of US deep sea mining.
insights.speaker: Dr Beatrice Browning, Frederick Bloomfield - Benchmark
insights.so_what: Deep sea mining equities are policy-binary bets.
insights.quote: why policy clarity will be critical to commercial development
